description: A compatibility-preserving diagnostic adapter for Self-EvolveRec. DiagnosisProbe(view, device) exposes run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), returning metrics and metric_definitions while inspecting the actual trained model through architecture-appropriate probes.
motivation: Support model diagnosis and iterative improvement under the shared RecHarness benchmark using only observed public data and a consistent validation objective.
implementation_notes: Retain the DiagnosisProbe interface and SASRec compatibility methods: item_emb, log2feats, predict_score, user_train, meta_data, and review_data. Adapt probes when the architecture changes. Training batches contain (None, sequence, positive, negative), with tensors shaped B × L. Use only interaction histories, titles, descriptions, and timestamps; mark unavailable review information and simulator traits as unobserved. Generate full-catalog unseen-item recommendations for 20 real training users, five per category. Rank trials by macro-average validation HR@10 across all four datasets. Preserve dataset routing, prescribed seeds, and the host evaluator.
pseudocode:
class DiagnosisProbe:
    initialize(view, device):
        store view and device
        bind architecture-compatible probes to view.model

    run_full_diagnosis(train_loader):
        preserve model training state
        set model to evaluation mode
        under no_grad:
            inspect valid sequence positions in training batches
            compute supported diagnostics from model outputs and observed data
            generate unseen-item recommendations for five training users per category
        restore model training state
        return metrics, metric_definitions

Select trial using host-computed macro validation HR@10.

originality.positive: Combines a stable diagnostic interface with explicit data-availability constraints and benchmark-aligned selection.
originality.negative: Describes an integration contract rather than a new recommendation algorithm or diagnostic method.

future_potential.positive: Can support comparable diagnosis across architecture changes and guide subsequent model improvements.
future_potential.negative: Its value depends on defining informative probes and showing that diagnosis-guided changes improve validation performance.

code_difficulty.positive: The required interfaces, batch structure, available data, and selection metric are clearly specified.
code_difficulty.negative: Architecture adaptation, padding-aware diagnostics, and full-catalog recommendation generation require careful implementation.
